update.title: Added controlled randomization to ComfyUI
update.summary: Built a ComfyUI node set for defining prompt pools, freezing useful selections, rerunning the rest, and saving the final choices with each generated image.

preview.description: Easy Randomize item pools and selection nodes in ComfyUI

blocks.body:
## Keep the useful choices

I built the node set around a short iteration loop: define pools of prompt fragments, queue a generation, freeze the selections that worked, and rerun the rest. Frozen values are stored in the workflow, so refining one part of a prompt does not require copying the whole combination into a new graph.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Pools[Define item pools] --> Select[Select values]
  Select --> Preview[Generate and preview]
  Preview --> Freeze[Freeze useful choices]
  Freeze --> Select
  Preview --> Record[Record final selections]
blocks.description: Each queue run changes only the selections that are not frozen.

blocks.body:
## Keep the workflow explicit

Item Pool and Smart Selector nodes keep the available choices visible in the graph and support random or sequential selection. String joiners, template fillers, and a freezable combiner assemble those choices into ordinary ComfyUI inputs instead of hiding prompt construction inside one generator.

blocks.description: Easy Randomize exposes item pools, selection controls, templates, recording, and image output as visible ComfyUI nodes.
The freezable combiner gives ten inputs independent freeze controls plus one control for the full set.

blocks.body:
## Save the choices with the image

Selection Recorder collects the chosen values as JSON, and Save Image with Selections embeds that record in the PNG metadata. A successful generation keeps both the image and the inputs that produced it, making the result reproducible without relying on memory or a screenshot of the graph.
